newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to sell fuel oil for 1H July.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to sell fuel oil for 1H July.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of three-percent sulphur fuel oil for first half July lifting, free-on-board (fob) Kaohsiung, a CPC official said on Tuesday.
The tender closes on June 10 and bids will be valid for two days. The cargo is 180-centistoke grade.
CPC sold three 30,000-tonne cargoes of three-percent sulphur fuel oil in its previous tender for June lifting at around $100 per tonne, fob Kaohsiung.
